earn.title: How you earn
earn.what.lead: Server purchases and their renewals that the people you invite pay by card or crypto: paid subservers, and bare-metal rentals and reservations once delivered.
earn.what.not: Not setup fees, Hoody AI, or any part paid with promotional, bonus or Referral credit. A purchase with a setup fee earns only on its server time.
earn.long.lead: 12 months per customer, from when their first qualifying server purchase is activated. Renewals earn too, but only for service inside those 12 months. Their first qualifying server purchase must be ordered within 90 days of signup.
earn.long.bare: Bare metal earns only in their first 3 calendar months of bare-metal service.
earn.hold.lead: Credit from each purchase is held for 60 days from activation, then becomes due at the first 00:00 UTC at or after the hold ends. Due credit first pays off anything you owe; the rest goes to your credit for servers.
earn.hold.note: Processing or a review can make it arrive later; refunds can reduce or reverse credit.
earn.creator: Reaching Creator
earn.creator.lead: You're a Creator for a month when, before it began, {{n}} or more customers you referred earned you credit that wasn't all reversed. The Creator share applies to purchases and renewals activated in a month you're a Creator; a prepaid term keeps the share of the month it was activated.
earn.creator.leadUnknown: You're a Creator for a month when, before it began, the Creator number of customers you referred earned you credit that wasn't all reversed. link.title: Your links
link.share: Each code is its own signup link. Every code earns you the same.
link.intro: A new account can become your referral when it's created through one of your links, or with one of your codes typed at signup. A link opened while signed out is remembered in the browser for up to 7 days, or until someone signs in. An earlier remembered code stays; one typed at signup replaces it. A retired or blocked code refers no one, and none of your codes does while your account isn't earning; the Program rules list the other exceptions.

faq.rate.a: You earn a share of what each person you invite pays for servers by card or crypto, without tax and after refunds: paid subservers (renewals too), and bare-metal rentals and reservations once delivered.
faq.notCounted.a: Not counted: setup fees, Hoody AI and AI Balance transfers, and any part paid with promotional, bonus or Referral credit.
faq.window.q: How long do I earn from each person?
faq.window.a: For 12 months from when their first qualifying server purchase activates. That purchase must be ordered within 90 days of their signup; delivery may come later. Only service inside that window earns credit.
faq.bareMetal.q: Do bare metal and prepaid purchases work differently?
faq.bareMetal.a: Yes. Bare metal earns only for three calendar months from their first bare-metal service start. Prepaid purchases earn only on the service that falls inside these windows.
faq.hold.q: When can I use my credit?
faq.hold.a: Credit from each purchase is held for 60 days from activation, then becomes due at the first 00:00 UTC at or after the hold ends and, after paying off anything you owe, goes to your credit. Processing or a review can make it arrive later. Refunds can reduce or reverse credit.
faq.spend.q: What can Referral credit pay for?
faq.spend.a: Referral credit pays for servers only. It can't be sent to another account or moved to AI, and it can't be withdrawn, except that Creators can ask Hoody support about withdrawing their credit.
faq.privacy.q: Can I see who signed up?
faq.privacy.a: You see totals only, never who signed up.
faq.eligible.a: Any delivered server purchase counts, including a plan, bare-metal rental or fulfilled reservation, if some of what you paid by card or crypto remains unrefunded. Credits and promotions don't count toward that paid amount.

guide.how.title: How you earn Referral credit
guide.how.body: You earn a share of what the people you invite pay for servers by card or crypto. How long: 12 months from when their first qualifying server purchase activates, and only service inside that time earns; that purchase must be ordered within 90 days of their signup. Bare metal earns only in their first 3 calendar months of bare-metal service. Setup fees, AI and anything paid with promotional, bonus or Referral credit do not count. When you can spend it: on servers, once it is due (the first 00:00 UTC at or after its hold of 60 days from activation ends) and has paid off anything you owe; processing, or credit under review, can make it later. Refunds can reduce or reverse it. The Program rules page has every detail.
guide.see.title: What you can see about the people you invite
guide.see.body: Only totals: how many signed up, how many pay and how many earned you credit recently, shown as "None yet", "Fewer than 3" or a number from 3. Never who they are.

faq.withdraw.a: Only accounts at the Creator level can ask to take Referral credit out as money: a Creator asks Hoody support about withdrawing their credit.
faq.creator.a: A customer counts when they are someone you referred, they have earned you Referral credit that became active before the month began, and that credit has not been fully taken back by refunds or account reviews. Counted over all time. Your level for each month is set from this count when that month's first qualifying purchase is processed; until then it's a preview and can still change. At the Creator number or more, you are a Creator for that month.
